## How this system runs

**What it is.** Before you decide, see what usually happens: graded base rates for life, work and policy choices, and your own forecasting record.

**The loop it closes.** An hourly beat re-reads each entry's source series for new releases and surfaces newer studies; readers' guesses before the reveal measure which base rates surprise most and order the site.

**How it bootstraps.** It is a tenant of the platform ([ultrastable/ultrastable](https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable)): its manifest is registered there, this repository holds its code, and the platform builds this repository's `main` into its Worker.

**How it runs.** Cloudflare Worker `ultrastable-base-rates`, deployed from this repository's `main` by the Ultrastable platform at base-rates.ultrastable.org; Cloudflare Pages project `base-rates`, ultrastable/base-rates loop.yml (GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages). Work is taken, done, verified and recorded by the system's own loops on a clock; a session or a person only adds ideas.
<!-- how:end -->
